ADAM WARLOCK.name: Quantum Magic
ADAM WARLOCK.desc: Launch quantum energy to deal damage

ADAM WARLOCK.name: Cosmic Cluster
ADAM WARLOCK.desc: Gather quantum energy into a cluster and then swiftly launch it at the enemy

ADAM WARLOCK.name: Karmic Revival
ADAM WARLOCK.desc: Awaken the karma of allies to revive them. Allies revived have lower health but enjoy a brief period of Invincibility

ADAM WARLOCK.name: Soul Bond
ADAM WARLOCK.desc: Forge a soul bond with allies, granting Healing Over Time and distributing damage taken across the bond

ADAM WARLOCK.name: Avatar Life Stream
ADAM WARLOCK.desc: Target an ally for a bouncing stream of healing energy, which also heals himself upon casting; self-targets if no ally is selected

ADAM WARLOCK.name: Karmic Revival
ADAM WARLOCK.desc: Take to the skies, entering a flying state and swiftly surge forward

ADAM WARLOCK.name: HEAVENLY HARMONY
ADAM WARLOCK.desc: Storm channels her elemental power into Adam Warlock. When Adam uses Soaring Surge, his movement speed is increased. While flying, Adam leaves behind a storm-charged trail that heals and speeds up allies within it

ADAM WARLOCK.name: Regenerative Cocoon
ADAM WARLOCK.desc: Once his body perishes, Adam Warlock can freely move as a soul and reforge his body at a chosen spot

Cloak & Dagger.name: Darkforce Cloak
Cloak & Dagger.desc: Inflict continuous damage on an enemy

Cloak & Dagger.name: Lightforce Dagger
Cloak & Dagger.desc: Unleash a bouncing Lightforce Dagger to damage enemies and heal nearby allies

Cloak & Dagger.name: Dark Teleportation
Cloak & Dagger.desc: Enshroud nearby allies in the Darkforce Dimension, plunging them into the Phased state, making them untargetable and invisible to enemies and granting them a Movement Boost

Cloak & Dagger.name: Dagger Storm
Cloak & Dagger.desc: Launch a volley of daggers, creating a Healing Over Time field in the impact area

Cloak & Dagger.name: Eternal Bond
Cloak & Dagger.desc: Perform four rapid dashes, healing allies and damaging enemies along the path

Cloak & Dagger.name: Eternal Bond
Cloak & Dagger.desc: Perform four rapid dashes, healing allies and damaging enemies along the path

Cloak & Dagger.name: Terror Cape
Cloak & Dagger.desc: Deploy a Veil of Darkforce to damage enemies upon touch, applying Blind to narrow their sight and Vulnerability to amplify damage received

Cloak & Dagger.name: Veil of Lightforce
Cloak & Dagger.desc: Deploy a Veil of Lightforce to heal allies upon touch and grant them a Healing Boost

Cloak & Dagger.name: FROM SHADOW TO LIGHT
Cloak & Dagger.desc: Cloak & Dagger inject light and dark energy into Hawkeye's katana. When Hawkeye uses Crescent Slash, enemies hit are launched back, and a blade wave filled with light and energy sweeps forward. This wave passes through both allies and enemies: it heals and boosts healing for allies, while damaging enemies and applying Vulnerability

DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - STRATEGIST
DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).desc: Nobody lays a finger on my teammates! Anyone tries, and I'm firing these big boy bullets straight at their face!

upgrade.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: I rack up shots, then, BOOM! A mind-blowing bubble bomb for all the enemies. Teammate security: maximum

DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).name: KICK@$$ KATANA - STRATEGIST
DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).desc: Protecting my team means my katanas go full savage. No mercy for the baddies!

upgrade.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Relax, you've got Deadpool on your side! Swords out, baddies out. My stab hits crit, and a Healing Hop hit makes the next swing a stabby special

DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).name: BOUNCING BOBBLEHEAD - STRATEGIST
DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).desc: Plushie power! It stops every single attack those chumps throw, giving my team a safety bubble. It's cute AND bulletproof

upgrade.name: BOUNCING BOBBLEHEAD - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: My ultra-cool, super shiny, extra huggable, and totally blinged-out plushy. Toss it ahead, and it lands as an invincible sphere of awesomeness! Blocking attacks and keeping my team safe inside our furry fortress

DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).name: HEALING HIJINKS - STRATEGIST
DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).desc: Try getting to my teammates, I dare you! My dash slash knocks fools down, and if I hit, I get to do it again. Up to three times, baby!

upgrade.name: HEALING HIJINKS - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Watch this pro bodyguard in action! I dash forward, nail the bad guy, and bounce in any direction I want. Oh, and I can do this two more times real quick!

DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).name: PWNAGE POUND
DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).desc: You! Yeah, you - the hyper one! Eyes off my friends. I sentence you to...whatever! Get ready to be taunted. I get bonus HP and healing, and if you whiff your abilities, you take damage, and I get even more HP!

upgrade.name: PWNAGE POUND - UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Upgraded courtroom drama! Congrats, unlucky one! You're my pick; enjoy the taunt! I score bonus health and healing, and you take ongoing damage. If you miss an ability while court is in session, it's a double whammy. You get more pain, AND I get more extra HP! Thanks in advance!

DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).name: FINAL EXAM
DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).desc: Wake the #!&% up, hero! We've got a game to win! Speed and healing buffs for starters, bonus Healing Hijinks for me, and extra HP for me and my nearby friends. Hit enough baddies with the right abilities exactly as I ask, and you unlock mega speed and healing, plus reset my Healing Factor cooldown!. Team protection mode: activated!

upgrade.name: FINAL EXAM - UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Hey, player! Warm-up's over, time for the main event! Speed, healing, dashes, for me, and bonus HP for all! Smash enough baddies with the skills I say, and you unlock super buffs(massive speed and healing), plus Healing Factor resets. For some time after, each hit means more HP for the crew and you. Don't mess this up!

DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - STRATEGIST
DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).desc: Want to hurt my team? Good luck! I hit you with a taunt, mess up your vision, and burn your health nonstop! Best part: my swords and guns go full turbo for the duration. Blink and you'll miss it

upgrade.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - STRATEGIST UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Teammates, stay safe! Dummies, look here! It's showtime: I taunt, blind you, and hit warp speed with my swords and guns. Plus, my crew gets a damage reduction buff, so they're basically invincible. Dummies that stick around too long will even have their UI taped over!

DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).name: UPGRADE!
DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).desc: I'm here to smack baddies, get XP, and shield my friends! When my XP is full, I get to upgrade an ability! Bonus: Score the final hit and force your foe into a selfie—more XP for me! I'm invincible while striking my best duckface. No photobombs!

DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).name: HEALING HOP
DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).desc: Yup, I can double jump in midair! During The Big Test and its upgrade, I can also stomp heads and wall jump to reset its cooldown. Stomp enemies so hard they won't get near my team!

DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).name: HEALING FACTOR
DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).desc: Out of combat? I'm healing up, staying battle-ready to protect my team. And if I'm about to croak? Surprise! I get a free pass, and my health zooms back up. Nice try, villains

DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).name: MAXIMUM FLAIR
DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).desc: Listen up, eyes on the prize, don't wander off! Every time my abilities land on a bad guy, the style points shoot up a notch! When it's full, I can pop my ultimate! With me on the team, you're all staying alive and fabulous!

DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).name: Comical Chaos
DEADPOOL (STRATEGIST).desc: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie with attitude. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously Taunt nearby enemies and Block Vision, while allies in range enjoy a plush-powered healing party!

Gambit.name: Kinetic Cards
Gambit.desc: Launch three kinetic-charged cards in an arc ahead. Each card detonates on impact, creating a single-target explosion that damages enemies and heals allies

Gambit.name: Bayou Bash
Gambit.desc: Channel kinetic energy into the bo staff, then slam it into the ground after a sweeping strike, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and heals allies

Gambit.name: Ragin' Royal Flush
Gambit.desc: Lock onto an ally within sight and unleash multiple Aces that heal and Purify. Both enter the Kinetic Transfer state, granting increased Movement Speed and Jump Boost, while enhancing attacks with additional single-target explosive damage and providing the ally with Ultimate Ability Charge Acceleration

Gambit.name: Cajun Charge
Gambit.desc: Side-step forward with bo staff in hand, dashing a short distance

Gambit.name: Healing Hearts
Gambit.desc: Conjure a Heart card by consuming one stack of  Sleight of Hand to Heal and switch to the Healing Hearts deck

Gambit.name: Bridge Boost
Gambit.desc: While Healing Hearts deck is active, trigger Flush Empowerment to card spring and fire a full deck forward. Cards bounce between allies on impact, granting Health and a Healing Boost

Gambit.name: Bidding Barrage
Gambit.desc: While Breaking Spades deck is active, trigger Raise Empowerment to scattering cards in an arc in all directions. Explosions damage enemies and Launch them up

Gambit.name: Breaking Spades
Gambit.desc: Conjure a Spade card by consuming one stack of  Sleight of Hand to gain Damage Boost and switch to the Breaking Spades deck

Gambit.name: Purifying Pick-Up
Gambit.desc: While Healing Hearts deck is active, trigger Raise Empowerment to launch a cluster of cards in an arc ahead. Explosions heal nearby allies and Purify them

Gambit.name: Explosive Trick
Gambit.desc: While Breaking Spades deck is active, trigger Flush Empowerment to fire a full set of cards forward. Cards explode on impact, dealing damage while inflicting Reduced Healing

Gambit.name: ACE OF ACES
Gambit.desc: Gambit charges Magneto's greatsword with kinetic energy. When Magneto activates this ability, Iron Volley is replaced with Ace Greatsword, which detonates upon striking enemies. The explosion leaves residual kinetic energy within the target, inflicting secondary damage after a brief delay

Invisible Woman.name: Orb Projection
Invisible Woman.desc: Launch a force field orbs that can pierce heroes, flying to maximum distance before returning to Invisible Woman; damaging enemies and healing teammates

Invisible Woman.name: Guardian Shield
Invisible Woman.desc: Generate a force shield in front of a selected ally or in front of you. The shield can block damage and provide Healing Over Time to nearby allies. Enemies that pass through the shield are slowed

Invisible Woman.name: Invisible Boundary
Invisible Woman.desc: Manifest an unseen force field within a chosen area, rendering allies inside undetectable by enemies and provide Healing Over Time. Enemies that pass through the field are slowed

Invisible Woman.name: Psionic Vortex
Invisible Woman.desc: Gather psionic energy and then cast it, upon impact or pressing the Ability key again, it erupts into a psionic vortex, continuously drawing in enemies and causing damage

Invisible Woman.name: Force Physics
Invisible Woman.desc: Manipulate psionic energy to push or pull enemies in front of her

Invisible Woman.name: Veiled Step
Invisible Woman.desc: Generate a force field at your feet, stepping on it propels her into the Invisible state

Invisible Woman.name: Covert Advance
Invisible Woman.desc: Enter Invisible state some time after disengaging from combat and grant yourself Healing Over Time

Invisible Woman.name: Fantasti-Force
Invisible Woman.desc: The Invisible Woman taps into her powers, channeling Psionic Might to fortify Mr.Fantastic. This formidable force bolsters Mr.Fantastic, granting damage resistance. Once activated, they can continually generate Bonus Health, making up for lost Health

JEFF THE LAND SHARK.name: Aqua Burst
JEFF THE LAND SHARK.desc: Launch a high-speed water sphere that bursts upon impact, dealing damage to enemies within range

JEFF THE LAND SHARK.name: It's Jeff!
JEFF THE LAND SHARK.desc: Deep dive into the scene and resurface to swallow both enemies and allies within range, activating Hide and Seek for a brief duration before ejecting the swallowed heroes forward

JEFF THE LAND SHARK.name: Hide and Seek
JEFF THE LAND SHARK.desc: Dive into the scene with only his dorsal fin exposed, granting himself a Movement Boost. Jeff can heal while submerged and gains the wall-crawl ability

JEFF THE LAND SHARK.name: Healing Bubble
JEFF THE LAND SHARK.desc: Spit a bubble that heals the ally who collects it, granting them Healing Boost and Movement Boost while also launching up nearby enemies

JEFF THE LAND SHARK.name: Jeff's Cuddle Buddy
JEFF THE LAND SHARK.desc: Jeff the Land Shark and Rocket Raccoon can ride on Groot's shoulders, receiving Damage Reduction

JEFF THE LAND SHARK.name: GUARDIAN OF THE DEEP
JEFF THE LAND SHARK.desc: Venom shares his symbiotes with Jeff and Hela. Jeff's Guardian of the Deep links with nearby allies, providing continuous healing. When the effect ends, it releases a powerful healing burst, converting any excess into Bonus Health.

JEFF THE LAND SHARK.name: IT'S JEFF-NADO!
JEFF THE LAND SHARK.desc: When Storm activates Omega Hurricane and Jeff the Land Shark's It's Jeff is ready, they can unleash a powerful Team-Up Ability. During this period, Storm's Omega Hurricane merges with Jeff to form a Jeff-nado

JEFF THE LAND SHARK.name: New Friends
JEFF THE LAND SHARK.desc: Jeff the Land Shark and Rocket Raccoon can ride on Groot's shoulders, receiving Damage Reduction

JEFF THE LAND SHARK.name: Oblivious Cuteness
JEFF THE LAND SHARK.desc: Reduce damage taken from critical hits

Jubilation Lee.name: Energy Plasmoids
Jubilation Lee.desc: Fire lumikinetic explosive light blasts forward to heal friends and damage foes. Triggering a Sparkle Mark briefly boosts Attack Speed and enables firing without consuming energy

Jubilation Lee.name: Blooming Ball
Jubilation Lee.desc: Launch a tracking orb of vampiric energy that damages enemies and heals allies in its radius. Striking the orb or hitting targets near it charges it up, increasing both its size and healing power. Press F to manually recall it.

Jubilation Lee.name: Firework Finale
Jubilation Lee.desc: Charge up and unleash a massive ring of outward-flying firework clusters, Knocking Back nearby enemies. These clusters then orbit you, creating a field that damages enemies and heals allies. Expanding the cluster radius outward will Launch Up struck enemies

Jubilation Lee.name: Sparking Sprint
Jubilation Lee.desc: Wrap yourself in vampiric energy to gain a Speed Boost. While active, jump height and Attack Speed are increased, and Energy Blasts can be fired at no cost

Jubilation Lee.name: Dazzling Detonation
Jubilation Lee.desc: Detonate a firework energy orb, dealing damage to enemies in the area and applying a Blind effect. The energy can also be transferred to an ally, granting them healing and a Speed Boost

Jubilation Lee.name: Sparkle Mark
Jubilation Lee.desc: Hitting targets with Dazzling Detonation and  Firework Finale applies a Sparkle Mark. Energy Plasmoids can detonate marks, granting allies a Healing Boost and Bonus Health, while dealing burst damage to enemies

LOKI.name: Mystical Missile
LOKI.desc: Fire Mystical Missiles to heal allies or deal damage to enemies. Direct hits on allies provide extra healing

LOKI.name: Deception
LOKI.desc: Become Invisible and conjure an Illusion to deceive enemies

LOKI.name: God of Mischief
LOKI.desc: Shapeshift into a targeted ally or enemy hero and use all their abilities except any of their Team-Up Abilities

LOKI.name: Regeneration Domain
LOKI.desc: Use Rune Stones to create a magical field that provides allies Healing and converts incoming damage into further healing

LOKI.name: Deific Blessing
LOKI.desc: Mantis enhances Groot's wooden walls and Loki's Rune Stones with life energy. Groot can additionally unleash a Flower Wall, which, when in Flora Colossus state, restores health to random nearby allies and grants them Damage Reduction. Loki's Rune Stones grant allies within Regeneration Domain a Damage Boost

LOKI.name: Doppelganger
LOKI.desc: Project an Illusion that can cast some of Loki's abilities

LOKI.name: Backstab
LOKI.desc: Pull out a dagger to stab enemies, dealing extra damage when attacking an enemy from behind

LUNA SNOW.name: Light & Dark Ice
LUNA SNOW.desc: Fire ice shots that damage enemies or heal allies

LUNA SNOW.name: Absolute Zero
LUNA SNOW.desc: Cast a clump of ice to Freeze the hit enemy and restore Health

LUNA SNOW.name: Fate of Both Worlds
LUNA SNOW.desc: Take center stage and start dancing! Press to toggle between two performances: Heal allies or grant them Damage Boost

LUNA SNOW.name: Ice Arts
LUNA SNOW.desc: Fire ice shards for a short duration, damaging enemies or healing allies while restoring her own Health

LUNA SNOW.name: Share the Stage
LUNA SNOW.desc: Attach Idol Aura to an ally. Allies with Idol Aura also restore Health when Luna Snow is healing others

LUNA SNOW.name: Number One Idol
LUNA SNOW.desc: Boost Healing. Gain extra healing when healing others

LUNA SNOW.name: SPIRIT FOX ACCORD
LUNA SNOW.desc: White Fox grants Luna Snow a spirit fox for protection. Luna can activate it for a burst of speed and fire it forward, healing allies in its path while applying Charm to enemies

LUNA SNOW.name: Cryo Heart
LUNA SNOW.desc: Automatically restore Health when casting Ice Arts or Absolute Zero

LUNA SNOW.name: Smooth Skate
LUNA SNOW.desc: Keep moving forward to start ice skating and enable higher jumps

LUNA SNOW.name: ICED OUT DIAMOND
LUNA SNOW.desc: Luna Snow grants Winter's Chill to Iron Fist and Emma Frost. When Iron Fist activates Harmony Recovery, he can heal nearby allies with Lunar Chi. Emma Frost can project ice energy forward, dealing damage and slowing enemies. She can also enhance her diamond form, condensing frost into an Absolute Zero Diamond barrier that blocks enemy attacks and movement

MANTIS.name: Life Energy Blast
MANTIS.desc: Fire an energy thorn and regain one Life Orb after a critical hit.

MANTIS.name: Healing Flower
MANTIS.desc: Consume Life Orbs to grant allies Healing Over Time

MANTIS.name: Soul Resurgence
MANTIS.desc: Release energy around her while moving, providing Healing Over Time and Movement Boosts for surrounding allies. Excess healing converts to Bonus Health

MANTIS.name: Spore Slumber
MANTIS.desc: Throw a spore to Sedate the nearest enemy

MANTIS.name: Allied Inspiration
MANTIS.desc: Consume Life Orbs to grant allies a Damage Boost

MANTIS.name: Natural Anger
MANTIS.desc: Consume Life Orbs to grant herself a Damage Boost

MANTIS.name: Nature's Favor
MANTIS.desc: Receive a Movement Boost when not injured and Healing Over Time when consuming Life Orbs

MANTIS.name: Heavenly Guardian
MANTIS.desc: Mantis enhances Groot's wooden walls and Loki's Rune Stones with life energy. Groot can additionally unleash a Flower Wall, which, when in Flora Colossus state, restores health to random nearby allies and grants them Damage Reduction. Loki's Rune Stones grant allies within Regeneration Domain a Damage Boost

ROCKET RACCOON.name: Bombard Mode
ROCKET RACCOON.desc: Fire energy projectiles that deal damage

ROCKET RACCOON.name: Repair Mode
ROCKET RACCOON.desc: Shoot bouncing spheres to heal allies

ROCKET RACCOON.name: C.Y.A.
ROCKET RACCOON.desc: Deploy a Cosmic Yarn Amplifier that grants allies a Damage Boost

ROCKET RACCOON.name: B.R.B.
ROCKET RACCOON.desc: Deploy a Battle Rebirth Beacon that revives a fallen ally and periodically produces armor packs and rocket jet packs

ROCKET RACCOON.name: Old Friends
ROCKET RACCOON.desc: Jeff the Land Shark and Rocket Raccoon can ride on Groot's shoulders, receiving Damage Reduction

ROCKET RACCOON.name: Wild Crawl
ROCKET RACCOON.desc: Hold Space to run on a wall

Ultron.name: IMPERATIVE: FIREWALL
Ultron.desc: Deploy drones to an ally marked by Imperative: Patch, granting them increased Speed and Damage. Additionally, all allies within range of you and the chosen teammate receive Bonus Health.

Ultron.name: RAGE OF ULTRON
Ultron.desc: Summon Ultron Drones to fire Encephalo-Rays, damaging enemies or healing allies

Ultron.name: DYNAMIC FLIGHT
Ultron.desc: Fly quickly in the direction of movement and then enter an Accelerated state

Ultron.name: IMPERATIVE: PATCH
Ultron.desc: Command up to 2 giant drones to follow 2 allies, constantly healing allies within its radius, with more healing for the designated allies.

Ultron.name: NANO RAY
Ultron.desc: When Iron Man, Ultron and Squirrel Girl team up, Ultron's Encephalo-Ray upgrades to Nano-Ray, firing a beam that pierces through all characters, dealing continuous damage to foes while healing allies; Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion!

White Fox.name: YEOWOO GUSEUL
White Fox.desc: Fire a Fox Marble forward that bounces off terrain or heroes, then homes in on nearby heroes. It damages enemies, heals allies, and restores Spirit Tail energy

White Fox.name: CLAW STRIKE
White Fox.desc: While Awakened, slash forward with a flurry of attacks

White Fox.name: NINEFOLD SLAM
White Fox.desc: In Kumiho Form, slam the ground, causing an explosive shockwave. Hitting enemies or summons grants One-Time Healing to self and nearby allies

White Fox.name: SPECTRAL SURGE
White Fox.desc: Consume one Spirit Tail to send a spectral fox forward. It heals and grants invulnerability to allies it passes through, damages and Charms enemies, forcing foes to move toward White Fox

White Fox.name: TAIL SWEEP
White Fox.desc: While Awakened, sweep forward tails to launch up hit enemies

White Fox.name: BLESSED BY THE NINE
White Fox.desc: In Kumiho Form, select an ally to grant Continuous Healing, Unstoppable, and Life-Steal for a short time

White Fox.name: KUMIHO UNLEASHED
White Fox.desc: Manifest the full Nine-Tailed Fox form and continuously heal nearby allies. Cannot receive healing effects from others while in this form

White Fox.name: SPIRIT SANCTUARY
White Fox.desc: Teleport to a chosen ally, instantly healing allies in the area while generating a shield

White Fox.name: Predatory Pounce
White Fox.desc: While Awakened, dash forward. Hit an enemy to slow them, enabling a second dash that knocks back enemies

White Fox.name: FOX FORM AWAKENING
White Fox.desc: Enter Awakened state, transforming Spirit Tails into physical tails. While active, continuously drain Spirit Tail energy and heal nearby allies. Striking enemies provides additional area healing

White Fox.name: NINE-TAILED AURA
White Fox.desc: Black Cat shares her luck with her allies. When White Fox embraces her newfound fortune, she unleashestracking Spirit Tails to grant Healing and Speed to allies, while damaging and Slowing foes. When Captain America enjoys his luck, his shield's block radius expands and allows him to aim deflectedProjectiles directly toward his target

White Fox.name: SPIRIT FOX WARD
White Fox.desc: White Fox grants Luna Snow a spirit fox for protection. Luna can activate it for a burst of speed and fire it forward, healing allies in its path while applying Charm to enemies
